newsitem.title: UK: French believe Channel Tunnel fire was arson - BBC.
newsitem.headline: French believe Channel Tunnel fire was arson - BBC.

text.p: A French inquiry into last year's blaze in the Channel Tunnel is expected to conclude that it was caused by arson, the British Broadcasting Corporation said on Thursday.
The BBC said the French legal inquiry into the fire, which caused 200 million pounds worth of damage, is likely to be published in the next few days.
The report's authors believe the fire was started deliberately, the BBC said.
The tunnel's operator, Eurotunnel Plc/SA, was severely criticised earlier this week in another report into the fire by the Channel Tunnel Safety Authority.
The blaze last November broke out in a freight shuttle wagon. Eight truck drivers were taken to hospital and Eurotunnel was forced to close its freight service.
Eurotunnel needs the permission of an Inter Governmental Commission (IGC) before it can restart the freight service.
The company said on Thursday evening that it was working closely with the IGC with the aim of resuming freight shuttle services by the middle of June.
